# The C probes that generate crates/starlink-ast/tests/*_oracle/cases.rs, read by
#   build    make: the Makefile; fast, plain, grflog, grflog-ownerr: the recipes in
#            check_probes_fresh.sh, each the compiler line the probe's header documents;
#            ctests: build_<probe>.sh, which builds the probe once per C test and runs it
#   run_dir  tools: tools/oracle_fixtures; build: the reference library's build directory;
#   env      VAR=value set for the run, or -
#   stdin    fixtures-list: the sorted list of .map, .simp, .ast and .native fixtures; or -
#   output   the generated file, relative to the repository root
#   known    why the committed file is known to differ from what the probe prints, or -;
#            the probe then reports KNOWN, and fails once it matches again, so that the
#            entry is removed by the change that regenerates or fixes the file
# crates/starlink-ast/tests/grid_oracle/cases.rs is not here: capture_grid_logs.sh writes it.
